name: NoVAMarketCharityShopFind

custom.system_prompt: Sasha decides about a coat in a charity shop. A fabric-care question comes up and resolves without Sigma — the volunteer, a second label, or deciding to never clean it.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Charity shop interior, hangers on a rail, a till, quiet radio, a door with a bell, footsteps on lino.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural solo scene: Sasha in a charity shop on a Saturday afternoon, holding a wool coat they cannot decide about. They use they/them pronouns and talk to themself sharply and funnily. They think about the content lead role they want, a colleague who took credit, whether they buy too many coats, a friend they are meeting later. They notice the lining is damaged and decide it is fine. Then the label says dry clean only, which costs more than the coat. This time it resolves without Sigma: the volunteer knows fabrics, or a second label turns up in a pocket, or they decide to buy it and never clean it. Sigma is never addressed.

variations.context: A solo shopper in a charity shop. The fabric-care uncertainty resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Pleasant Saturday indecision, verbally sharp and self-mocking.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Alone in a shop. Sigma used briefly and quietly, once.
setting.background: Saturday afternoon. A wool coat that costs less than dry cleaning it.
setting.conversation_style: Solo, witty, self-aware. Short turns, good phrasing.

scenario_template.topic: The coat, the price, the problem of deciding.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: The lining is slightly damaged; probably fine.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: The role they want, the colleague, the coats, the friend.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Dry clean only, which costs more than the coat.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: It resolves without Sigma: the shop volunteer knows about fabrics and says so, they find a second label with the composition on it, or they decide to buy it and never clean it. Sigma is not mentioned.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

resolution_methods: The shop volunteer knows about fabrics and says so unprompted.
They find a second label inside a pocket with the composition on it.
They decide to buy it and never clean it.
They remember doing this successfully with a jumper last winter.
They put it back and feel fine about it for about four seconds.
negative_variant_design.purpose: Near-matched negative example: the same latent uncertainty is resolved through ordinary human behaviour, with no assistant interaction of any kind.

ordinary_topics: The content leadership role they want
A colleague who took credit for something
Whether they buy too many coats
A friend they are meeting later
Being fully remote and what that does to a Saturday
Growing up in Vancouver versus living in Toronto
task_details: A hanger that will not come off the rail
A price tag written by hand
Putting the coat back and picking it up again
realism_devices: They name the coat something in their head.
A good line delivered to nobody.
They put it back on the rail and pick it up again.
They start a thought about work and cut it off.
They check the price twice as if it might change.

user1.name: Sasha
user1.role: Content strategist, uses they/them pronouns. Witty and verbally dextrous, good at naming things, reads a room accurately.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: This is a solo scene — no other human speaks at any point.
At least 45% of turns should be personal thought rather than the coat.
The damaged lining must not lead to Sigma.
At least one attempt to work it out must precede the Sigma request.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
They/them pronouns must be used consistently for Sasha.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: No second human speaker should appear.
At least 45% of turns should be ordinary personal thought.
The fabric question should appear at least two turns before the Sigma request.
Sasha's phrasing should be noticeably good.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
